style.description: The ktfmt style to start from. The other options override its settings.

oneOf.description: Meta style, ktfmt's default: 2-space blocks, 4-space continuations, trailing commas only added.
Google internal style: 2-space blocks and continuations.
Kotlin coding conventions: 4-space blocks and continuations.

lineWidth.description: The maximum line width. Defaults to the global lineWidth, or 100 if that is not set.

blockIndent.description: Spaces to indent a new block. Defaults to the style's value.

continuationIndent.description: Spaces to indent a line broken for being too long. Defaults to the style's value.

trailingCommas.description: How to manage trailing commas. Defaults to onlyAdd for the meta style and complete otherwise.

oneOf.description: Adds trailing commas to lists broken across lines and removes them elsewhere.
Adds trailing commas to lists broken across lines and never removes them, so they can force a break.
Leaves trailing commas as they are.

preserveLambdaBreaks.description: Whether to keep lambdas that span multiple lines in the input on multiple lines.

newLineKind.description: The kind of newline to use. Defaults to the global newLineKind, or auto.

oneOf.description: For each file, uses the first newline kind found in the file.

useTabs.description: ktfmt only indents with spaces, so this can only be false.
